2395-the-golden-fleece-and-the-heroes-wh.title: The Golden Fleece And The Heroes Who Lived Before Achilles
2395-the-golden-fleece-and-the-heroes-wh.creator: Unknown
2395-the-golden-fleece-and-the-heroes-wh.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The blue sky was above him, the great trees stood away from him, and the little child lay at his feet. He waited, and then he heard the thud-thud of great hooves. And then from between the trees he saw coming toward him the strangest of all beings, one who was half man and half horse; this was Chiron the centaur.

arxiv-2006-00391.title: Langevin equation with nonlocal boundary conditions involving a
arxiv-2006-00391.creator: ψ
arxiv-2006-00391.description: Abstract Abstract. This paper studies Langevin equation with nonlocal boundary conditions involving a \psi –Caputo fractional derivatives operator. By the aide of fixed point techniques of Krasnoselskii and Banach, we derive new results on existence and uniqueness of the problem at hand.

arxiv-2012-10256.title: Atomic transitions for adaptive optics Journal: josab
arxiv-2012-10256.creator: Rui Yang, Joschua Hellemeier, Paul Hickson
arxiv-2012-10256.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Rui Yang, Joschua Hellemeier, Paul Hickson. Adaptive optics systems using sodium laser guide stars are widely employed at major astronomical observatories. It is natural to ask whether other atomic species might offer advantages. In this paper we review all abundant atoms and ions in the upper atmosphere, including Na, Fe, Mg + , Si + , Ca + , K and also the non-metallic species N, N + , O, H, considering their potential for adaptive optics.

arxiv-2107-14237.creator: Anna Karczewska
arxiv-2107-14237.description: Abstract In most of the studies concerning nonlinear wave equations of Korteweg-de Vries type, the authors focus on waves of elevation. Such waves have general form u u ​ ( x , t ) = A ​ f ​ ( x − v ​ t ) u_{\text{u}}(x,t)=Af(x-vt) , where A > 0 A>0 .

arxiv-2304-07948.title: Sustainable AIGC Workload Scheduling of Geo-Distributed Data Centers: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Approach
arxiv-2304-07948.creator: Siyue Zhang, Minrui Xu, Wei Yang Bryan Lim, and Dusit Niyato, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2304-07948.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Siyue Zhang, Minrui Xu, Wei Yang Bryan Lim, and Dusit Niyato, Fellow, IEEE. Recent breakthroughs in generative artificial intelligence have triggered a surge in demand for machine learning training, which poses significant cost burdens and environmental challenges due to its substantial energy consumption. Scheduling training jobs among geographically distributed cloud data centers unveils the opportunity to optimize the usage of computing capacity powered by inexpensive and low-carbon energy and address the issue of workload imbalance.

arxiv-2306-00590.title: A Note on the Spectrum of Magnetic Dirac Operators This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Global Analysis on Manifolds in honor of Christian Bär for his 60th birthday. The full collection is available at https://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/Baer.html
arxiv-2306-00590.creator: Nelia CHARALAMBOUS a and Nadine GROSSE b
arxiv-2306-00590.description: Abstract In this article, we study the spectrum of the magnetic Dirac operator, and the magnetic Dirac operator with potential over complete Riemannian manifolds. We find sufficient conditions on the potentials as well as the manifold so that the spectrum is either maximal, or discrete. We also show that magnetic Dirac operators can have a dense set of eigenvalues.

arxiv-2308-11060.title: Kinematics of the Milky Way from the Statistical Analysis of the Gaia Data Release 3
arxiv-2308-11060.creator: Petr Zavada, Karel Píška
arxiv-2308-11060.description: Abstract The aim of the analysis of data from the Gaia Space Observatory is to obtain kinematic parameters of the collective motion of stars in a part of our galaxy. This research is based on a statistical analysis of the motion of 55,038,539 55,038,539 stars selected in different directions from the Sun up to a distance of 3–6 kpc.

arxiv-2312-04030.title: Modeling Boundedly Rational Agents with Latent Inference Budgets
arxiv-2312-04030.creator: Athul Paul Jacob, Abhishek Gupta, Jacob Andreas
arxiv-2312-04030.description: Abstract We study the problem of modeling a population of agents pursuing unknown goals subject to unknown computational constraints. In standard models of bounded rationality, sub-optimal decision-making is simulated by adding homoscedastic noise to optimal decisions rather than explicitly simulating constrained inference.

arxiv-2501-04696.title: Test-Time Optimization for Domain Adaptive Open Vocabulary Segmentation
arxiv-2501-04696.creator: Ulindu De Silva, Didula Samaraweera, Sasini Wanigathunga, Kavindu Kariyawasam, Kanchana Ranasinghe, Muzammal Naseer, Ranga Rodrigo
arxiv-2501-04696.description: Abstract We present Seg-TTO, a novel framework for zero-shot, open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS), designed to excel in specialized domain tasks. While current open-vocabulary approaches show impressive performance on standard segmentation benchmarks under zero-shot settings, they fall short of supervised counterparts on highly domain-specific datasets. We focus on segmentation-specific test-time optimization to address this gap.

arxiv-2503-18062.title: Investigating Recent Large Language Models for Vietnamese Machine Reading Comprehension
arxiv-2503-18062.creator: Anh Duc Nguyen, Hieu Minh Phi, Anh Viet Ngo, Long Hai Trieu, Thai Phuong Nguyen
arxiv-2503-18062.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable proficiency in Machine Reading Comprehension (MRC) tasks; however, their effectiveness for low-resource languages like Vietnamese remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we fine-tune and evaluate two state-of-the-art LLMs: Llama 3 (8B parameters) and Gemma (7B parameters), on ViMMRC, a Vietnamese MRC dataset.

arxiv-2504-01777.description: Abstract Rogue patterns associated with multiple roots of Adler–Moser polynomials under general multiple large parameters are studied in integrable systems. arxiv-2504-11637.title: DamageCAT: A Deep Learning Transformer Framework for Typology-Based Post-Disaster Building Damage Categorization
arxiv-2504-11637.creator: Yiming Xiao, Ali Mostafavi
arxiv-2504-11637.description: Abstract Rapid, accurate, and descriptive building damage assessment is critical for directing post-disaster resources, yet current automated methods typically provide only binary (damaged/undamaged) or ordinal severity scales. This paper introduces DamageCAT, a framework that advances damage assessment through typology-based categorical classifications.

arxiv-2507-11946.title: Bootstrap prediction intervals for the age distribution of life-table death counts
arxiv-2507-11946.creator: Han Lin Shang
arxiv-2507-11946.description: Abstract We introduce a nonparametric bootstrap procedure based on a dynamic factor model to construct pointwise prediction intervals for period life-table death counts. The age distribution of death counts is an example of constrained data, which are nonnegative and have a constrained integral. A centered log-ratio transformation is used to remove the constraints.

pmc-11478261.title: Biochemical Modulators of Tight Junctions (TJs): Occludin, Claudin-2 and Zonulin as Biomarkers of Intestinal Barrier Leakage in the Diagnosis and Assessment of Inflammatory Bowel Disease Progression
pmc-11478261.creator: Aleksandra Górecka, Agnieszka Jura-Półtorak, Ewa M Koźma, Anna Szeremeta, Krystyna Olczyk, Katarzyna Komosińska-Vassev, Hiroyuki Kataoka
pmc-11478261.description: Background: Considering the increasing worldwide prevalence of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), the early diagnosis of this disease is extremely important. However, non-invasive diagnostic methods remain limited, while invasive techniques are the most commonly used in daily practice. Therefore, there is a serious need to find new non-invasive biomarkers of IBD.

pmc-12469145.title: A Model Framework for Ion Channels with Selectivity Filters Based on Non-Equilibrium Thermodynamics
pmc-12469145.creator: Christine Keller, Manuel Landstorfer, Jürgen Fuhrmann, Barbara Wagner
pmc-12469145.description: A thermodynamically consistent model framework to describe ion transport in nanopores is presented. The continuum model unifies electro-diffusion and selective ion transport and extends the classical Poisson–Nernst–Planck (PNP) system for an idealized incompressible mixture by including finite ion size and solvation effects. Special emphasis is placed on the consistent modeling of the selectivity filter within the pore.

pmc-12578948.title: Novel strategies for enhancing lap spliced reinforced concrete beam behavior for mitigating failure risk
pmc-12578948.creator: Sabry Fayed, Moataz Badawi, Mohamed Ghalla, Rabeea W Bazuhair, Ehab A Mlybari, Abdulaziz Alaskar
pmc-12578948.description: In addition to one control beam with continuous tensile bars and one control beam with splice, nine reinforced concrete (RC) beams with lap-spliced bars were constructed and strengthened. This was carried out in order to enhance the flexural performance of RC beams that had a short tension reinforcement splice.

pmc-12684771.title: Empagliflozin Improves Cardiomyocyte Function in Phospholamban‐R14del Cardiomyopathy by Regulating Calcium/Calmodulin‐Stimulated Protein Kinase II Activity and Apoptosis
pmc-12684771.creator: Anna P. Hnatiuk, Alexander W. Li, Barbara E. Vecci, David W. Staudt, Ricardo Serrano, Xiaozhi Gao, Peter P. Q. Tran, Mark Mercola
pmc-12684771.description: el) in the coding region of the phospholamban gene A single deletion of arginine 14 (R14del) in the coding region of the PLN (phospholamban) gene (PLN‐R14del) leads to dilated cardiomyopathy associated with severe ventricular arrhythmia and a high risk of sudden cardiac death and heart failure.

pmc-12690752.title: SBPS-10 POSTOPERATIVE EVOLUTION OF PITUITARY ADENOMAS RETAINED BY TRANSSPHENOIDAL ENDONASAL ENDOSCOPIC APPROACH : IVORIAN EXPERIENCE OF 150 CASES
pmc-12690752.creator: Landry Teti, Landry Konan, Soress Dongo, Konan Serges Yao, Bernard Fionko, Traore Aboubakar, Ange Yao, Désirée Kofi, Mbiakeu Jorel, Dzidoula Lawson, Louis Derou, Valentin Tokpa, Aderehime Haidara, Jacko Abodo
pmc-12690752.description: IntroductionTranssphenoidal endonasal endoscopic surgery has established itself as the preferred approach for the treatment of pituitary adenomas. Although this minimally invasive approach offers excellent results in terms of tumor resection and reduced morbidity, the quality of postoperative medical care remains a determining factor in functional prognosis.

pmc-13059536.title: Association of GlyCD147 with carotid atherosclerosis: evidence from integrative analyses
pmc-13059536.creator: Cuihong Tian, Peixuan Yang, Xingang Li, Hongxia Zhang, Jieyi He, Jinxiu Zhu, Yequn Chen, Xuerui Tan
pmc-13059536.description: BackgroundAtherosclerosis is an inflammatory cardiovascular disease that progresses with ageing. Glycosylation plays a significant role in inflammation and contributes to the pathogenesis of ageing-related diseases, including atherosclerosis. Cluster of differentiation 147 (CD147), a glycosylated agonist of matrix metallopeptidase 9 (MMP9), serves as an inducer of atherosclerosis and atherothrombosis. However, the effect of glycosylated CD147 (GlyCD147) on atherosclerosis remains unclear.

pmc-13302371.title: Persistent Hypercoagulability After Radical Prostatectomy: Biomarker Dynamics and Implications for Individualized Thromboprophylaxis
pmc-13302371.creator: Matyas Benyo, Marie Al-Muhanna, Zsuzsanna Molnar, Janos Docs, Tamas Takacs, Jolan Harsfalvi
pmc-13302371.description: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) remains a clinically relevant complication of radical prostatectomy despite advances in surgical techniques and perioperative care. Current thromboprophylaxis strategies are largely based on fixed-duration approaches and static risk models focused on the early postoperative period. However, accumulating evidence suggests that postoperative hypercoagulability is a dynamic and prolonged process that may extend beyond this timeframe.

pmc-13338158.title: Two-layer evolutionary optimization problem for home healthcare pathways and scheduling under multi-center resource sharing
pmc-13338158.creator: Xinmiao Shao, Zhong Wu, Qing Guo
pmc-13338158.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). To address inter-center workload imbalance and low resource utilization in multi-center home healthcare systems, this study proposes a bilevel optimization approach for routing and scheduling that enables cross-center resource sharing. First, we formulate a weighted single-objective model that jointly accounts for travel time, service costs, penalties for time-window violations, and workload-imbalance penalties, thereby providing a unified representation of multi-criteria trade-offs while incorporating skill-matching and labor-compliance constraints.

pmc-13373384.title: Patterns of antidepressant treatment changes among adults with major depressive disorder in Northwest Ethiopia: a hospital-based cross-sectional study
pmc-13373384.creator: Tilaye Arega Moges, Fasil Bayafers Tamene, Woretaw Sisay Zewdu, Getachew Yitayew Tarekegn, Asanti Dejen, Tigabu Eskeziya Zerihun, Abel Temeche Kassaw, Desalegn Addis Mussie, Samuel Agegnew Wondm, Abaynesh Fentahun Bekalu, Samuel Berihun Dagnew
pmc-13373384.description: Background:Major depressive disorder (MDD) is a prominent cause of worldwide disability, severely affecting quality of life in Ethiopia. Despite a significant prevalence of treatment-resistant depression, challenges in treatment adherence, and a high prevalence of adverse drug reactions, the studies in Ethiopia have limited data on antidepressant treatment changes.

pmc-13637105.title: Evaluation of pulp stone between a sub-group of Iraqi population using CBCT radiographs: a retrospective observational study
pmc-13637105.creator: Tara Rasool Hussein AL-Barazanchi
pmc-13637105.description: BackgroundPulp stones (PS) or denticles are a type of calcification foci that are found in the coronal pulp or, less frequently, radicular pulp cavity. The appearance of PS might hinder endodontic treatments in some cases.ObjectiveTo examine the distribution of PS in a subgroup of the Iraqi population and to detect the factors that induce this condition among patients.

pmc-13689298.title: Maternal exposure to PM2.5 and its components and risk of small for gestational age in women undergoing in vitro fertilization: a propensity score-matched case-control study in Guangzhou, China

pmc-13689298.description: BackgroundPregnant women conceiving via in vitro fertilization (IVF) represent a uniquely vulnerable population, yet the impact of ambient fine particulate matter (PM2.5) and its specific chemical components on their fetal growth remains under-researched. This study aimed to investigate the associations between prenatal exposure to PM2.

pmc-13719155.title: Reconstruction of a Self-sustaining System of Oscillating Glycolytic Reactions in Artificial Microreactors
pmc-13719155.creator: O. M. Alekhina, P. V. Bashkirov, A. S. Silantyev, S. P. Dudik, D. S. Matyushkina, O. V. Shcherbakova, V. M. Govorun
pmc-13719155.description: Synthetic cell design is one of the daunting challenges of modern biology. While the genome synthesis problem has already been solved technologically, the understanding of the molecular composition of the intracellular environment required for initiating artificial life still remains elusive. One of the mechanisms of self-organization in prebiotic systems is the oscillatory processes (oscillations) arising from feedback regulation.
